The '''WorldArmor 9 Planetary Shield''' was a common type of [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] system produced by [[MerrWeapons]]. It was a type of encasing shield, making it cheaper to produce and able to operate longer, but created a solid wall of energy which did not allow friendly ships and weapons fire to pass through except heavily-guarded firing slots or gaps. The generator required a crew of twenty-five to operate.<ref name="HS" />
